name: Census
description: Census, now part of Fivetran Activations, moves governed warehouse data into business tools through datasets, sources, destinations, syncs, audience activation, and operational workflows.
agentUseSummary: Add a separate Census workspace API key; agents can read only an identity-free aggregate dataset count through one fixed endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: CENSUS_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Census workspace API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a separate workspace API key for Relay in Census/Fivetran Activations API Access, store it securely, and regenerate or delete it if exposure is suspected.

capabilities.label: Read dataset readiness summary
capabilities.description: Count workspace datasets while excluding dataset identity, SQL, sources, destinations, syncs, runs, profiles, and customer data.

approvalRequired.label: Get Census dataset readiness summary
approvalRequired.description: Return only the pagination-reported aggregate dataset count from the fixed Census dataset-list endpoint.

blocked.label: Access dataset identity, query, or schema
blocked.description: Dataset IDs, names, descriptions, resource identifiers, types, SQL, schemas, columns, cached record counts, and related metadata remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access profiles, records, events, or customer data
blocked.description: Profiles, identities, records, row values, events, attributes, behaviors, traits, audiences, memberships, PII, consent, and raw customer data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access sources, destinations, syncs, or runs
blocked.description: Connections, credentials, source/destination identity, sync configuration, mappings, schedules, runs, row and operation counts, errors, logs, and delivery state remain blocked.

blocked.label: Trigger, create, update, delete, or administer Census
blocked.description: Sync triggers, tests, refreshes, datasets, sources, destinations, webhooks, variables, users, workspaces, tokens, settings, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, methods, headers, queries, bodies, filters, pagination, polling, retries, Terraform, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded dataset count requires approval; identity, SQL, customer data, connections, syncs, runs, writes, administration, raw APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded count runs directly; workspace ownership, key authority, redaction, response cap, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed identity-free Census dataset-count wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed Census wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: Census/Fivetran Activations requires a workspace API key for its Management API; safe use requires a separate key, correct workspace/access confirmation, secure storage, network compatibility, rotation/revocation planning, and live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A workspace administrator creates a separate API key, confirms it resolves only the intended workspace and dataset access, accounts for network controls, records rotation/revocation ownership, and completes a live read-only acceptance check.

evidence.supports: Fivetran Activations documents workspace API keys with Bearer authentication, private token handling, and immediate regeneration or deletion after suspected compromise.
The official API reference documents GET https://app.getcensus.com/api/v1/datasets, workspace-scoped dataset listing, page/per_page/order bounds, and pagination.total_records.
The Management API documents page 1, bounded per_page, descending order, total_records, and next-page metadata for collection endpoints.
The official Census reference documents broader sync configuration, mapping, scheduling, and status data plus create, update, delete, test, and trigger surfaces; Relay excludes them.

securityNotes: Relay encrypts the customer-owned workspace key and sends it only as a Bearer credential to the fixed https://app.getcensus.com origin; it is never returned to agents.

Relay allowlists only GET /api/v1/datasets?page=1&per_page=1&order=desc, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, caps the response at 1 MB, accepts no runtime input, and never paginates, polls, or retries automatically.
Output contains only pagination.total_records as datasetCount; dataset identity, SQL, schemas, source details, syncs, runs, profiles, events, row values, and customer data are excluded.
All tests, refreshes, triggers, mutations, administration, raw APIs, Terraform, and bulk remain structurally unavailable in both approval profiles.
Key creation, workspace/access confirmation, network-policy review, secure capture, rotation/revocation planning, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
